errors.text_span: The shortest bar, associated with chLSTM at position L₄⁺
errors.evidence: The shortest bars in the chart are for chLSTM at positions R2 and R3, which have negative Shapley values (approximately -1). The bar for chLSTM at L₄⁺ has a positive value of approximately 1.
The value of the chLSTM bar at position L₄⁺ is approximately 1, not 3.

errors.text_span: the tallest bar, corresponding to mBERT at position T
errors.evidence: The tallest bar in the chart corresponds to the chLSTM model (light green), not the mBERT model (light blue), at position T.
This value is incorrectly associated with the mBERT bar at position T. The value for mBERT at T is approximately 58. The value 78 (or 79) corresponds to the chLSTM bar at T.

errors.text_span: Generally, the chLSTM bars are consistently shorter than the other two models.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect and a major misrepresentation of the data. The tallest bar in the entire chart belongs to the chLSTM model at position T, where it is significantly taller than the other models.

errors.text_span: Some bars are visually emphasized with a darker shade of the respective color.
errors.evidence: There is no visual emphasis on any bars using darker shading. The bars have distinct solid colors and a black outline, but no special emphasis.
